plan.Goal: Deliver full sandbox isolation for Windows Skia/Vulkan toggles

Environment-Check.Action: Inspect toolchains for Windows Skia/Vulkan builds/tests
Environment-Check.Result: Ubuntu container lacks Windows compilers, Vulkan runtime, and GUI, so builds/tests cannot run.

plan.context: Scope every toggle marked UNSANDBOXED for the Windows Skia/Vulkan path in Plan/Sandbox-Report-Initial.md. Each task must reach implementation-ready clarity with file-level touchpoints, state management notes, logging/telemetry expectations, and validation approach even though Windows builds cannot run here. New requirement: address the Skia/Vulkan compilation failures where ctx is undefined, VulkanContext usage is mis-specified, and VkImage push_back arguments do not match, restoring a clean Windows build.

task.name: IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_WIN
task.crucialInfo: Sandbox builds now route window class registration, timer ownership, and font caches through SandboxWinState so every renderer keeps its own HWND metadata and teardown paths with explicit logging on failure.
task.continue-info: Follow-up audits can concentrate on remaining Win32 helpers such as clipboard/drag-drop, but no shared globals remain for the sandbox toggles covered.

task.name: Catalogue shared Win32 state
task.crucialInfo: Documented fallback statics: nWndClassReg/wndClassName guard the shared window class, sFPS remains the process timer accumulator when WIN_TIMERS is off, and sPlatformFontCache/sHFontCache retain shared font caches whenever WIN_FONTS is disabled; sandbox instances still lean on global gHINSTANCE from IPlug headers.
task.continue-info: Design renderer-owned storage for window class bookkeeping, timer IDs, HWND handles, and font caches so WIN umbrella toggle can flip all code paths without globals.

task.name: Implement per-instance state container
task.crucialInfo: Introduced SandboxWinState on IGraphicsWin so window class reference counts, class names, and timer metadata live with the renderer rather than globals.
task.continue-info: Follow-up entry point work should consume SandboxWinState so all Win32 helpers read/write per-instance storage.

task.name: Guard Win32 entry points
task.crucialInfo: OpenWindow now registers per-instance classes only once, emits sandbox-aware diagnostics when RegisterClass/CreateWindow fail, tears down Vulkan state on failure, and CloseWindow unregisters classes with logged error handling.
task.continue-info: Entry points share no global state; monitor future additions for sandbox compliance.

task.name: IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_WIN_TIMERS
task.crucialInfo: Display timer creation, reuse, and teardown now route through StartDisplayTimer/StopDisplayTimer so each sandboxed renderer owns its timer ID and cadence.
task.continue-info: Monitor integration with VSYNC threads and idle paths when Windows tooling is available.

task.name: Map timer lifecycle
task.crucialInfo: Located every SetTimer/KillTimer call and centralized them behind StartDisplayTimer/StopDisplayTimer wrappers tied to SandboxWinState.
task.continue-info: No further action required until VSYNC fallback behaviour is audited on Windows.

task.name: Implement per-instance timer registry
task.crucialInfo: SandboxWinState tracks the timer ID, active flag, and cadence so SetTimer/KillTimer interactions are confined to the owning IGraphicsWin.
task.continue-info: Confirm timer registry interacts correctly with hosts that rapidly open/close windows.

task.name: Verify timer isolation logic
task.crucialInfo: WM_TIMER dispatches assert that callbacks stay on the owning DisplayTimerId before handing off to OnDisplayTimer.
task.continue-info: Augment the assertion with logging once centralized logging is hooked into sandbox builds.

task.name: IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_VULKAN
task.crucialInfo: All Win32 Vulkan handles now live inside SandboxVulkanState with helper accessors so context creation, swapchain rebuilds, and teardown operate strictly on renderer-owned storage with sandbox-aware logging.
task.continue-info: Future Vulkan work can focus on Skia resource caches; Win32 integration honours sandbox isolation.

task.name: Inventory Vulkan shared state
task.crucialInfo: Win32 Vulkan bootstrap now enumerates instance/device/swapchain/semaphore state into SandboxVulkanState so no globals remain.
task.continue-info: Skia resource caches will be audited under VK_CONTEXT.

task.name: Gate Vulkan bootstrap on toggle
task.crucialInfo: OpenWindow binds Vulkan creation through per-instance helpers and emits sandbox diagnostics when initialization fails, unregistering the window class to avoid shared fallout.
task.continue-info: Monitor additional backends when new toggles wire into Vulkan bootstrap.

task.name: Define sandbox fallback behaviour
task.crucialInfo: Failure paths now tear down partially constructed windows, drop the class registration, and log the sandbox decision so hosts can fall back cleanly.
task.continue-info: Document fallback expectations in future Windows sandbox notes.

task.name: IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_VK_DEVICE
task.crucialInfo: SandboxVulkanState now owns the device coordinator, VkDevice, and queue handles so teardown waits on the device and clears members without relying on globals.
task.continue-info: Allocator sandboxing can build atop the new per-instance state container.

task.name: Track current device ownership
task.crucialInfo: VkInstance, VkDevice, queue family, and coordinator handles are scoped to SandboxVulkanState.
task.continue-info: Allocator adjustments will extend the sandbox struct.

task.name: Isolate device creation/destruction
task.crucialInfo: CreateVulkanContext and DestroyVulkanContext mutate SandboxVulkanState, waiting on the sandboxed device and resetting handles deterministically.
task.continue-info: Observe Windows validation once device allocator work resumes.

task.name: Audit allocator + queue reuse
task.crucialInfo: Queues, fences, and semaphores are accessed via SandboxVulkanState helpers so swapchain management never touches shared globals.
task.continue-info: Command pool sandboxing can hook into the same struct.

task.name: IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_VK_SWAPCHAIN
task.crucialInfo: Swapchain holders, image vectors, semaphores, and fences reset through SandboxVulkanState so each renderer tears down its own synchronization primitives with logged failures.
task.continue-info: Additional GPU backends can reuse the sandbox helpers for swapchain lifecycle management.

task.name: Audit swapchain caches
task.crucialInfo: VkImage vectors and semaphores moved into SandboxVulkanState eliminating shared static caches.
task.continue-info: Monitor Skia swapchain caches under VK_CONTEXT.

task.name: Create per-instance swapchain manager
task.crucialInfo: SandboxVulkanState encapsulates swapchain handles, format, usage flags, and helper accessors used during create/resize.
task.continue-info: Hook further swapchain diagnostics into the struct if needed.

task.name: Enforce deterministic teardown
task.crucialInfo: DestroyVulkanContext waits on the sandboxed device, resets swapchain/semaphore holders, and logs teardown, ensuring per-instance cleanup.
task.continue-info: Validate with Windows tools when available.

task.name: IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_VK_CONTEXT
task.crucialInfo: SkiaVulkanContextState now owns the Vulkan command pool, swapchain images, synchronization primitives, and logging context so sandbox builds keep handles renderer-scoped while legacy builds reuse the shared singleton when the toggle is disabled.
task.continue-info: Windows validation should confirm the shared fallback and per-instance teardown against validation layers once tooling is available.

task.name: Review Skia context sharing
task.crucialInfo: Audited IGraphicsSkia to catalogue every Vulkan handle and cache that previously lived on the class regardless of sandbox configuration.
task.continue-info: None.

task.name: Bind per-instance Skia context state
task.crucialInfo: Introduced SkiaVulkanContextState with accessor helpers so enabling IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_VK_CONTEXT switches to per-instance storage while disabled runs share the global state.
task.continue-info: Future Vulkan work can extend the struct with allocator metadata.

task.name: Add validation hooks
task.crucialInfo: Reused the existing Vulkan logging macros through the new accessors so every lifecycle branch emits sandbox-aware diagnostics without additional globals.
task.continue-info: Observe validation output on Windows once Vulkan tooling is accessible.

task.name: IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_DRAW
task.crucialInfo: IGraphics now treats the draw umbrella as authoritative, promoting bitmap/SVG caches to instance storage whenever the toggle is set so legacy builds keep shared statics only when the sandbox is disabled.
task.continue-info: Documented the behaviour shift and umbrella expectations for Windows hosts.

task.name: Identify shared draw caches
task.crucialInfo: Confirmed the StaticStorage bitmap/SVG caches were the remaining shared draw resources affected by the umbrella toggle.
task.continue-info: None.

task.name: Enforce umbrella behaviour
task.crucialInfo: Added the IGRAPHICS_USE_INSTANCE_GRAPHICS_CACHES guard so IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_DRAW unconditionally routes caches through instance members.
task.continue-info: Legacy builds continue to use static caches when the umbrella is disabled.

task.name: Document sandbox contract
task.crucialInfo: Updated WindowsSandbox.md to describe the new Vulkan context state container and draw umbrella semantics for sandbox hosts.
task.continue-info: Cross-link with future validation notes once Windows automation exists.

task.name: IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_TEXTURE_CACHE
task.crucialInfo: Bitmap/SVG caches now honour IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_TEXTURE_CACHE by switching StaticStorage ownership to renderer members whenever the texture sandbox or image sandbox toggles are enabled.
task.continue-info: Future GPU texture caches can reuse the same macro guard.

task.name: Audit texture cache usage
task.crucialInfo: Identified IGraphics::StaticStorage caches as the texture-sharing point and gated them on the new sandbox macro.
task.continue-info: None.

task.name: Implement per-instance cache
task.crucialInfo: IGraphics::BitmapCache/SVGCache return per-instance storage when either image or texture sandbox toggles are enabled, ensuring caches live with the renderer.
task.continue-info: Monitor additional caches when new draw backends are added.

task.name: Instrument cache lifecycle
task.crucialInfo: Retain/release hooks already emit through StaticStorage; no additional logging required after enabling sandbox gating.
task.continue-info: Consider verbose logging when Windows automation is available.

task.name: IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_LOGGING
task.crucialInfo: VulkanLogging now exposes per-instance logger contexts and global fallbacks so sandbox builds no longer share sinks or verbosity.
task.continue-info: Completed via new LoggerContext/ScopedLoggerBinding helpers and IGraphicsWin-owned context; no further action pending.

task.name: Map logging ownership
task.crucialInfo: Identified global sink/verbosity storage and replaced with sandbox-aware accessors.
task.continue-info: Handled in VulkanLogging.h by introducing GlobalLogSink/Verbosity helpers.

task.name: Bind logging lifecycle to instance
task.crucialInfo: IGraphicsWin now stores a LoggerContext and binds it around Vulkan operations.
task.continue-info: Implemented ScopedLoggerBinding usage in Create/Destroy/Resize Vulkan flows.

task.name: Expose sandbox logging controls
task.crucialInfo: Added per-instance sink/verbosity accessors on IGraphicsWin for sandbox hosts.
task.continue-info: Further adjustments can use SetVulkanLogSink/SetVulkanLogVerbosity APIs.

task.name: IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_VK_LOGGER
task.crucialInfo: Thread-local fallback replaced with LoggerContext binding so each renderer controls its sink.
task.continue-info: Sink access now flows through IGraphicsWin::SetVulkanLogSink and ScopedLoggerBinding.

task.name: Design Vulkan log sink API
task.crucialInfo: Defined LoggerContext struct and ScopedLoggerBinding to manage sink routing.
task.continue-info: IGraphicsWin exposes setters to wire custom sinks.

task.name: Implement sandbox-aware sink storage
task.crucialInfo: LoggerContext lives on the renderer and ResolveLogSink consults the active binding.
task.continue-info: vk debug logging automatically follows the bound context.

task.name: Add diagnostics for sink wiring
task.crucialInfo: Logging payload now includes sink context without global collisions; additional diagnostics not required.
task.continue-info: ResolveLogSink honours the current ScopedLoggerBinding for verification.

task.name: IGRAPHICS_SANDBOX_VK_LOG_LEVEL
task.crucialInfo: Verbosity now travels with LoggerContext so sandboxed renderers select independent log levels.
task.continue-info: Per-instance Get/Set APIs on IGraphicsWin adjust verbosity without global side effects.

task.name: Expose per-instance log level knobs
task.crucialInfo: IGraphicsWin::SetVulkanLogVerbosity exposes runtime control for sandbox clients.
task.continue-info: Verbosity stored on LoggerContext and read via ResolveVerbosity.

task.name: Persist log level alongside sink
task.crucialInfo: LoggerContext bundles verbosity with sink so ResolveVerbosity honours the bound renderer.
task.continue-info: Scoped bindings ensure VulkanLogging uses the renderer's stored severity.

task.name: Validate level switching hooks
task.crucialInfo: ResolveVerbosity consults the active context so updates take effect immediately across log events.
task.continue-info: Global fallback remains available via ResetVerbosity for non-sandbox runs.

task.name: FIX_VULKAN_CTX_COMPILATION_ERRORS
task.crucialInfo: Windows Skia/Vulkan builds fail because ctx is undefined throughout IGraphicsSkia Vulkan paths, VulkanContext references use pointer-to-member syntax errors, Vulkan image vectors receive mismatched arguments, and related helper declarations lack headers. Centralized the VulkanContext definition so both IGraphicsWin and IGraphicsSkia see the same struct, then renamed it to PlatformVulkanContext with a compatibility alias so the renderer can reference the shared state without triggering the VulkanContext() accessor collision.
task.continue-info: Focus on authoring the remote validation recipe for Windows builds once the outstanding verification subtask completes.

task.name: Trace ctx data flow regression
task.crucialInfo: Identified that ctx originated from the Windows Vulkan bootstrap but the struct lived only in IGraphicsWin.h; promoted the definition into a shared Platforms/VulkanContext.h include consumed by both the window and Skia renderer to restore pointer scope.
task.continue-info: Monitor additional sources (e.g. Linux Vulkan) in case they require the shared header during future work.

task.name: Correct VulkanContext definitions
task.crucialInfo: Shared header keeps the VkImage vector pointer and semaphore/fence handles consistent; struct now lives as PlatformVulkanContext with a legacy VulkanContext alias so downstream callers keep compiling while Skia disambiguates its accessor methods. Windows bootstrap now instantiates PlatformVulkanContext explicitly to avoid the VulkanContext() member accessor collisions that previously yielded pointer-to-member syntax errors.
task.continue-info: Confirm that any additional Vulkan helpers include the shared header instead of re-declaring the struct.

task.name: Verify Windows Skia/Vulkan compile
task.crucialInfo: Create a code-review validation plan covering clang-cl/msvc builds since local toolchain unavailable; document assumptions.
task.continue-info: Record steps/flags future agent must run to confirm once Windows environment is available.

task.name: FINAL CHECK
task.crucialInfo: Perform code review of all toggles (build tests unavailable). Transition tasks to REVIEW PASSED when complete.
